csharp_space_between_parentheses #

Spacing inside parentheses. ⚠ Recorded as inert — "the oracle returns the file unchanged at control_flow_statements, so this MS-compat spelling reaches nothing" — and that is wrong. Measured at false against control_flow_statements, the oracle writes if ( a > 0 ), while ( … ), for ( … ), foreach ( … ) and catch ( … ), exactly as skala_space_between_parentheses_of_control_flow_statements does. It is observable and unimplemented, which is a different thing from inert. ⚠ Blocked on the one mechanism the registry does not have: expands propagates a generalized key's value TEXT into the keys it names, so it can only reach targets whose domain — and whose polarity — is its own. Three keys need the same missing piece and none of them is a coverage gap: this one, csharp_space_between_parentheses and csharp_new_line_before_members_in_object_initializers. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against the oracle at 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified implementable — blocked on a polarity-aware expands. Verified: four distinct oracle outputs over false, control_flow_statements, expressions and type_casts on a fixture carrying if, while, for, foreach, catch, a parenthesized expression and a cast; Skala is flat at all four. The recorded correction — observable and unimplemented rather than inert — holds. An oracle glob would report INERT.

Typeany combination, comma-separated, of control_flow_statements, expressions, type_casts, false
Defaultfalse
Default known fromnothing beyond the export
TierD — recorded so the key is not reported unknown; nothing reads it yet
